title: Healing of Many Sick at Sunset
description: When the sun set, people brought to Jesus those who were sick with various diseases. He laid his hands on each one and healed them. Demons also came out of many, crying out that he was the Son of God. But Jesus rebuked them and would not let them speak, because they knew he was the Messiah [ref:Luke 4:40-41|Luke 4:40-41].
